title: Engineering hiring funnel Q3
brief: Recruiting asked for a Q3 2026 hiring funnel page for the Engineering org at Lumen Health. Four tiles: Applicants 2140, Offers made 38, Offers accepted 31, Median time to hire 34 days. Section titled "Funnel": a bar chart (horizontal is fine) of candidates at each stage: Applied 2140, Recruiter screen 612, Technical screen 287, Onsite 119, Offer 38, Accepted 31. Section titled "By role": a table with columns Role, Openings, Applicants, Onsites, Hires, Days open: Backend Engineer, 6, 840, 44, 12, 41; Frontend Engineer, 4, 520, 29, 8, 30; Data Engineer, 3, 410, 25, 6, 37; SRE, 2, 230, 14, 3, 52; Engineering Manager, 2, 140, 7, 2, 66. Section titled "Acceptance rate": a line chart of offer acceptance rate in percent by month: Jan 71, Feb 75, Mar 78, Apr 80, May 74, Jun 83, Jul 85, Aug 79, Sep 84. Close with a note in a callout: SRE and Engineering Manager roles are taking the longest, and the team proposes adding a referral bonus of $3000 for those two roles starting 2026-11-01.
